errors.evidence: The description states that the markers on the data points are line-shaped ('strichförmig'). However, the markers in the figure are clearly circular dots ('Kreismarkierungen').

errors.text_span: Im Jahr 2015 verzeichnet die Linie einen weiteren explizit beschrifteten Datenpunkt mit einem Wert von 0,97.
errors.evidence: The data point labeled with 0.97 is located at the year 2015 on the x-axis, which is between the 2014 and 2016 tick marks. The machine-generated description incorrectly identifies this year as 2015, while the human reference correctly identifies it as 2016.
